To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the algorithmizable approach to normalization of UML class diagrams yields better design and that the resultant design is easier to implement.
the object-oriented data modeling can be normalized and the normalization can be algorithmically performed.

we have developed an approach to the normalization of the object oriented data model in algorithmizable form, which can be applied to the object-oriented data models and can be implemented in the CASE tool Craft.CASE.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: How to normalize an object-oriented data model?
the algorithmic transformation of the object-oriented design model.
the algorithmizable modeling of the object-oriented modeling and its application in Craft.CASE, the object-oriented CASE tool.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the object-oriented data modeling process can be automated and the resultant design can be evaluated.
the object-oriented data modeling is a complex task that requires an appropriate tool support to be successful.
the object-oriented design process is not an art but a science and the quality of the object-oriented design can be evaluated.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have designed an approach that is able to transform an object-oriented conceptual model into a normal object-oriented data model.
we have developed the algorithm to normalize the object-oriented model and the CASE tool based thereon, which is able to normalize the UML class diagram.
we have developed an algorithm for the object-oriented model normalization, a CASE tool for the object-oriented design and an algorithm for the algorithmization of the object-oriented design.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have developed a formal approach for the design of object-oriented conceptual models and the algorithm for their normalization based on the model transformation rules.
the normalization of the object model is a useful and necessary process in the object-oriented analysis and design.
the normalization of object-oriented data model can be done in algorithmic way and the resultant design is of better quality.
